Apple.title: Marketing / Sales Associate
Apple.description: Entry-level contributor supporting campaigns, retail operations, or sales initiatives. Executes well-defined tasks under guidance.

Apple.title: Marketing / Sales Specialist
Apple.description: Independently executes campaigns or sales processes. Contributes to customer engagement and supports revenue goals.

Apple.title: Senior Specialist
Apple.description: Owns key campaigns, product messaging, or regional sales performance. Drives measurable business impact.

Apple.title: Manager
Apple.description: Leads teams or major initiatives. Defines strategy for campaigns or sales programs and ensures execution excellence.

Apple.title: Senior Manager
Apple.description: Drives large-scale marketing or sales programs across regions or product lines. Aligns execution with business goals.

Apple.title: Director
Apple.description: Defines organizational strategy for marketing or sales. Oversees multiple teams and drives significant business outcomes.

Apple.title: Senior Director / VP
Apple.description: Sets long-term vision and direction for major business units. Influences company-wide marketing or sales strategy.
